LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 14.3.1 ADVERBS OF TIME

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of time, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we identify adverbs of time used in written sentences? 2) How can we construct correct sentences using adverbs of time?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. recognise adverbs of time (soon, late, now, today, tomorrow, early, morning, afternoon) in a text.

2. construct sentences using adverbs of time.

3. engage in meaningful question- and- answer dialogues using adverbs of time.

4. role play a conversation on child labour using adverbs of time.

5. fill in blank spaces in sentences using appropriate adverbs.

6. sing / recite short poems/rhymes to practise the use of adverbs of time. 1)

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. recognise adverbs of time (soon, late, now, today, tomorrow, early, morning, afternoon) in a text.
2. construct sentences using adverbs of time.
3. engage in meaningful question- and- answer dialogues using adverbs of time.
4. role play a conversation on child labour using adverbs of time.
5. fill in blank spaces in sentences using appropriate adverbs.
6. sing / recite short poems/rhymes to practise the use of adverbs of time. 1)

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of time together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy as the learner gains confidence in self-expression using the adverbs of time

• Learning to learn- through use of the adverbs of time in a variety of contexts.

Values:
Responsibility as learners indirectly learn about time management as they handle adverbs of time.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (effective communication) by using adverbs of time in self-expression.

Link to other Learning Areas

Adverbs of time are used in all learning areas.
